name: block-fit
description: Re-check stage after block-triage: does one shortlisted block really render this section? Run once per candidate; the highest fit below the bar means a new block (#127).

fields.candidate: { name, description, rows: 'what an author fills', excerpt: 'first lines of the block's decorate or its README' }

instructions.question: Does `candidate` render `section` from the same authored rows — the same roles in the same order and the same repeat structure?
instructions.focus: A different visual treatment is fine (a variant class). A different row structure is not a fit.

criteria.true: The candidate's rows carry every role the section has, in a compatible order and repeat structure.
criteria.false: The section has roles or a repeat structure the candidate's rows cannot carry, or the candidate carries roles the section lacks and needs.
